notes.title: Today we are going to remove 7 Legacy Steam achievements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/d476cf34409cb286d72fd8dfdcad8230d6ddd1c3.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear MFL Steam Community,[/b]

Today we are going to remove 7 Legacy Steam achievements, specifically the following:
[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/c2edf0c29f0816bc5a298b7242afe8fe9bd8251e.jpg[/img] Blitzburgh Steelheads
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/45112f83e47e311092d7140ba5e2e04213114d9c.jpg[/img] Cardinal Sins
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/a8194002a6eb3115c10b51e1934cced2e61684b0.jpg[/img] Grim Bay Attackers
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/adc85a0a026b5c54f19d79fbad355d4d8440cd2e.jpg[/img] Leaveland Burns
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/4f2615e86ddcb867d826d1755b97a4584cb03f4c.jpg[/img] Malice Hellboys
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/2e8d16f6e8441c4160a3e64e1141c96c0960cc2e.jpg[/img] Mile High Chronic
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/a8194002a6eb3115c10b51e1934cced2e61684b0.jpg[/img] Motor City Maniacs
[/list]

Since our game's initial release back in 2017, we’ve kept these 7 achievements to honor those who achieved them. However, times change, and so do games.
With the release of Dynasty Edition in 2018, we made significant updates, including the unlocking of all parody teams - a feature requested by the passionate MFL Steam community. While these achievements have remained in the game, they have lost relevance since they cannot be achieved, and many members of our vibrant community have expressed their desire for their removal - since it is not possible for them to complete all the achievements 100%. This sentiment is not limited to a small group; it represents the majority of players who now outnumber those early achievers.
We understand that change can be challenging, and no matter what direction we take, some members of our community may be disappointed. For this, we sincerely apologize. Our aim is to ensure that Mutant Football League continues to be a welcoming and enjoyable experience for both new and longtime players.
That's why we've made the decision to remove these achievements, effective immediately after the publication of this announcement. We believe this change will better accommodate the evolving landscape of MFL and provide a fair playing field for everyone.
We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to our early players who achieved these milestones. Your dedication has been integral to the growth and success of Mutant Football League. We hope you understand that this decision has been made with the best interests of the entire community in mind.
As always, we value your feedback and engagement. Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or concerns. We are committed to making Mutant Football League an even more enjoyable and inclusive experience for all.

 Also, as we’ve promised earlier [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/529520/discussions/0/3806154232470698472/]here (check the thread)[/url], we’re preparing to release MFL - Complete Bundle which will include base and all DLC for the game. Please check the MFL store page after October 10th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/23d5d4589e7b1e0ae1d0a3160adda49eed831ee2.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you for being a part of our fantastic community, and we look forward to seeing you on the gridiron!

The Mutant Football League Team[/b]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/a893873f1e1d682f612411cd44ba894ab83e96d4.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello MFL fans![/b]

We have some great news for you - all 4 final parody teams DLCs are available in the [b]Steam[/b] store right now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/9d509bd1e1f75a9cf7551dea2207603d9b576618.png[/img]
Release The [b]Diami Krakens[/b] onto the field! This team has revamped their offense, headlined by the fastest wide receivers in the league, and they just might give this team a shot at a Mayhem Bowl championship. Their home stadium, Hard Schlock Stadium, is a real son of a beach, with 100 yards of sand filled with Piranha Pits and Mutant Worms.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093190
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/30d999ca1fd9cead6742047862030564362555a2.png[/img]
The [b]New Yuck Threats[/b] added some much-needed pieces around their Sophomore QB, drafting arguably the best new class of talent in the MFL. With the dangers of Threatlife Sstadium, including two massive buzzsaws, a maze of landmines, and blood-filled moats, the Threats might be less of a threat and more like a promise of pain and dismemberment. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093232
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/590d54d2644be8743abf87464863bcdb4b2715d4.png[/img]
If that’s not enough landmines and buzzsaws for you, head over to Insurrection Field, home to the [b]Brainwashington Cadavers[/b]. There’s poison, too! Can never have enough poison. Just ask Rasputin. The Cadavers hope they’ve finally figured out their quarterback situation, and they know they have the pieces to build a great defense guaranteed to strike fear into opposing quarterbacks. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093230
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/9dffbf4473b7fc3edd4259e2dd4de00fb59583bd.png[/img]
Last up is the [b]Sinsonasty Mangles[/b], a team that goes balls out on deep passes with the best QB and WR duo in the game. Or is it balls deep on out passes? Either way, they’re explosive, which is an apt description as well for Concrete Jungle Stadium. Literally. Things tend to blow up there, if the spikes, fire pits, and traps don’t get you first.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093231

[b][i]Thank you for support and see you on the field![/i]
The MFL Team[/b]

notes.title: 13.02.2018 Steam Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/ee2cbfc1e9282cb137a1a2bc1d30a72d83822e1c.jpg[/img]

Hey guys!

With this update, ping should be drastically improved (especially for the guys from West Coast). Now we try to connect you to the opponent directly. And if that fails - via relay server. You can see current connection type in the right bottom corner: direct or relay.

Also, we got rid of launcher! If for some reason you'll want to summon it, just launch the game with Shift key pressed.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Used direct connection between players when possible.
[*]Removed Unity launcher.
[*]Fixed QB Sack Attack not killing QB if Karnage Level is set to Off.
[*]Fixed Evils logo being flipped in halftime and end of game stats.
[*]Other fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Run your own Mayhem Bowl with free Killadelphia Evils team![/h1]
That’s right, so get ready for the biggest game of the year because we’ve added the Killadelphia Evils team and home arena to this update and it’s all FREE!!!

[h1]But that’s not all…[/h1]
MFL players can stage their own Mayhem Bowl matchups with our new Mayhem Bowl play mode.

The new Killadelphia Evils update includes a new Evils team theme song, "It's After Midnight," performed by Lucky Boys Confusion, courtesy of Mutant League Records, the newest Indie jam to appear in Mutant Football League.

Check out our 2018 Mayhem Bowl simulation of this weekend's big game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CLrqFFwugzQ

[h1]Additional changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]"Expendable" players are now clearly marked throughout the game (statistics menus, etc.)
[*]Online improvements.
[*]"Gore" game option (turn on/off gore).
[*]If you lose a season or playoffs, you can now see who the winner was.
[*]Separate playoffs/season team and player statistics.
[*]New credits theme.
[*]Other fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: BUY MFL TOMORROW AND SAVE 5 BUCKS!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/5ec278e343cc8f8816dd281454ef3e5fe0a3bb45.jpg[/img]
Hi Steam Players,

We’re 24 hours from our console launch. The game will be releasing on [b][i]Playstation 4[/i][/b] and [b][i]XBox Live[/i][/b] on [b]Friday, January 19th[/b].

We want to extend a warm thanks to all of you for purchasing the game, and to everyone from our [b]Early Access[/b] players to current players who are providing great feedback and input to make this game awesome. From everyone on the MFL team we want to extend a heart-felt [b]THANK YOU[/b]!!!

Right now, our main focus is to get as many people playing this game as possible. We have a young, fun game, and over time it will mature and only get better. To help, we’re reducing the Steam Price to a competitive price of $19.99. More players mean more people playing online and cutting $5 should go a long way to boost the number of blood-filled, bone crunching hits and positive buzz.

Features we are working on include [i]Dynasty Mode[/i], which allows to play multiple seasons to take a low rated existing team and make it a Dynasty. You will be able to customize team playbook, [i]Dirty Tricks[/i] and most importantly gain player experience. Also, You'll be able to upgrade Players from Rookies all the way up to All-Stars. [i]Dynasty Mode[/i] will be delivered for [b]FREE[/b] in late February / March time frame. We hope this helps take some of the sting away from the price reduction.

Thank you all again for making this game possible. You guys [b]ROCK[/b]!!!

notes.title: 03.01.2018 Steam Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/2b02a015125080d3a3f7e48431a00dd4adbad99a.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! We had a busy December - we’ve finally certified MFL on Xbox and PS4. And right now we are working on new game mode called Dynasty. We are going to release several updates prior to Dynasty release, which will address various QoL issues you’ve reported us.

[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Auto saves. If you leave the match via Pause Menu -> Exit. you can continue playing it later.
[*] Online match notification. If someone searches for a random online match - the notification will appear in left-top corner. If you are in a single game - you can join the online match via Pause Menu -> Join Online Match. You can continue playing single game match from the moment you left later (thanks to auto saves).
[*] New running camera mode. Game Options -> Running Camera.
[*] Roster Depth screen, which helps manage your starters. You can access it via Season dashboard or Bench screen.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Max quarter time is 7
[*] Improved UI in pre-snap for offense team (defense is in progress)
[*] You can check your routes before kicks too
[/list]

Also, from today it’s possible to play online matches in MFL demo. Enjoy!

Digital Dreams Entertainment is taking part in the [i]12 Days of Indie[/i] - 5th Annual Charity Event 

[h1]What is 12 Days of Indie?[/h1]
It is a 12 day, 24 hour a day - Charity marathon to raise funds for Toys 4 Tots.

[h1]Where does it take place?[/h1]
It takes place on Twitch partner channel: http://www.twitch.tv/indie

[h1]When does it take place?[/h1]
It starts December 1st and ends on December 12th. 

[h1]What is the goal?[/h1]
To raise $12,000 USD for Toys for Tots and bring devs together with streamers and the viewers to reach said goal.

[h1]What can you do for the event?[/h1]
Making as many people aware of the event as possible. In past years the event had gotten time on the Front Page of Twitch and shouted out on Twitch Weekly, but getting it out over social media as much as possible is a big big big bonus!

notes.title: MFL Longer Range Plans…
notes.notes:
One of the things the MFL Team has tried hard to do is to involve our community with our future plans for the product early on. 
First, none of this happens if the game is not successful. You can help us make the game successful by promoting it through your social sites, by writing reviews and streaming.
Here is the direction we are heading over the next 6 months providing the game can generate enough revenue to allow us to do this:

[h1]Ports:[/h1]

Windows 10 Version
Develop a Switch Version
Develop a Mobile Version
Apple / Mac - TBD

[h1]Game Enhancements / Expansions:[/h1]

There are 2 routes we can go. One is to keep improving the game and move it towards a more competitive E-Sports structure, by allowing players to construct their own teams, rosters, playbooks and arena hazards with a balanced ratings system. The other is to create a Franchise / Story Mode where we can bring our characters to life. Our community has requested both of these major features over the last year. Both are solid features and directions for the game to go.

Initially, we want to create tools that allow Players to create their own content. Once that is in place we will be looking seriously into creating a story mode. This would be completely different than anything you’ve ever experienced in a sports game before. However, a story / franchise mode requires a deep narrative and universe creation, which requires time, the right people working on it and serious money to develop. We do want to develop this feature, but the property needs to prove itself worthy of this kind of investment first. 

For the immediate future we plan to focus on the following:

[b]Enhancements / Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] More Species (Demons, Werewolves, etc.)
[*] Online enhancements (co-op, 4 player, etc.).
[*] Improved Tackling Animations
[*] Season Improvements
[*] More Dirty Tricks
[*] Community Request / Feature development
[*] Graphical improvements
[/list]

[b]Sandbox Creation Tools:[/b]
[list]
[*] Team Editor (create your own team, name team, team colors, etc.)
[*] Play Editor (create your own plays and playbook)
[*] Arena Editor (name your arena, choose your field, hazards, etc.)
[*] Player Editor (Name players, pick species types, add ratings – with a balanced rating system – everyone has the same number of ratings points and how you allocate them amongst your players is up to you)
[*] League Structure with competitive leader boards
[/list]

So there you have it, these are the plans we have in place moving forward. If the game is successful we will certainly start building the brand into a viable property, and the best way to do that is through story development. 
Please let us know you like or disagree with the plan.

Concerning developing new games like Hockey or Soccer, etc. All of you, the MFL community will let us know what you want, and that’s what we will build, providing there are funds to allow us to develop a new game.

A lot is riding on this title, so please help us spread the word.

Thank you for your support!!!

The MFL Team.

notes.title: 10/19/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE

Hi there! We've finally delivered another Steam update. And it has some major changes:

[h1]Game Speed[/h1]

Based on your feedback we've added Game Speed setting. It makes game faster or slower by changing some global attributes. You can switch it before each match in Team Selection screen (press X - Game Settings). We need your help to figure out what option should be default. Please, try it out and fill our survey:

[h1]Other fixes and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] More drama in Team Selection screen
[*] Rain VFX
[*] Various camera fixes
[*] AI fixes (timeouts logic, field goal logic)
[*] Various season UI fixes (schedule screen mostly)

[*] Fix pause timer in online mode
[*] It was possible to play mini game 2 times in one game. Not anymore
[*] Fixed smack talk phrases after dirty trick play
[*] And many more less interesting fixes...
[/list]
